checker.upstream_pr: https://github.com/bendlang/bend/pull/1210 (head 45663e0a; closed, not merged); aa99b746 was never submitted upstream
checker.provenance: A fork branch, not a Bend release. Upstream bendlang/bend main at 01875127 (after v2.0.34) plus two commits on Giulio2002/bend rigid-subterms: 45663e0a 'A copy met after an unfold converts before either copy unfolds' (the full conversion pass asks the rigid, no-def-unfolds comparison again at each pair of calls of one def before unfolding them) and aa99b746 'A conversion recurses as deep as before the rigid retry' (the retry's memo no longer adds a stack frame per level, so conversions reach stock 2.0.34's depth). 45663e0a was the head of bendlang/bend#1210, closed without merging; aa99b746 was added to the branch afterwards and never submitted upstream; like the #1075 build pinned before it, this checker is trusted as the reviewed diff on top of upstream, not as an upstream release. Built on the ssz server at /srv/ssz-optimization/toolchain-rigid-aa99b746: bend-src/ is a clean checkout of aa99b746; bend2/ and guide/ are copies of its bend2/ and guide/; bin/bend = `bun build --compile bend2/main.ts --outfile ../bin/bend` run in bend-src/ with Bun 1.4.2 (its sha256 depends on the sources, Bun and the output file's name, not its directory: an independent rebuild elsewhere reproduced c9f6bedd; the bend2/ sources are pinned too). It is a release layout like v2.0.34's: bin/bend reads Base from ../bend2/base.bend.

sha256_package.name: bend-collections@1.0.0.0 (BendHub)
sha256_package.role: spec/ uses its FIPS 180-4 model (spec/crypto/sha.bend) as the hash of the specification; src/ uses its byte API, proved against that model inside the package.
sha256_package.provenance: hub.bend-lang.com/name/bend-collections@1.0.0.0 -> 0xd9a2fae439ac7ff9e21e0853948f94fe; the whole package (142 files, each checked against its manifest line; the id is the first 128 bits of the manifest sha256). The Bend 2.0.34 port of the SHA-256 model and proofs (no Nat.div.fin / Nat.mod.fin).
